subject: MdePkg: Replace non-ASCII characters with ASCII
reasons: The changes are comment and documentation text replacements, not semantic C transformations.
The edits replace curly apostrophes with ASCII apostrophes in prose, which is pure text cleanup.
There is no repetitive before/after code pattern across multiple call sites or files that Coccinelle could generalize.
This fits the excluded category of style and formatting changes rather than API migration or collateral evolution.
